sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片打碟的那个年代，

sentences.en: Shannon Mulcahy's job in an Indiana steel plant was headed to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 香农·穆尔卡希在印第安纳州一家钢铁厂的工作即将被转移到墨西哥。

sentences.en: Donald Trump vowed to keep those kinds of jobs inside the United States.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普誓言要将这类工作留在美国国内。

sentences.en: How the promise of America first has collided with the reality of American manufacturing.
sentences.zh: “美国优先”的承诺是如何与美国制造业的现实发生碰撞的。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 10 月 18 日，星期三。

sentences.en: We're going to bring jobs back.
sentences.zh: 我们要把工作岗位带回来。

sentences.en: We're bringing jobs back to our country.
sentences.zh: 我们要把工作岗位带回我们的国家。

sentences.en: We're not going to let Carrier leave.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不会让开利公司离开。

sentences.en: We're going to take numbers.
sentences.zh: 我们要开始算账了。

sentences.en: We're going to do numbers.
sentences.zh: 我们要拿出成绩来。

sentences.en: There are consequences when you leave.
sentences.zh: 离开是有代价的。

sentences.en: And we'll talk about Carrier because say what you want, Indiana.
sentences.zh: 我们要谈谈开利公司，因为不管你怎么说，印第安纳州。

sentences.en: I've been talking about Carrier now for four months, right?
sentences.zh: 我谈论开利公司已经四个月了，对吧？

sentences.en: Before I even knew that we were going to be coming.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我知道我们要来之前。

sentences.en: I mean, literally from the day.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真的是从那天起。

sentences.en: Literally from the day.
sentences.zh: 真的是从那天起。

sentences.en: Just a mile down the road from the Carrier plant in Indianapolis is the Rexnerd plant,
sentences.zh: 在印第安纳波利斯的开利工厂往下一英里处，就是雷克斯诺德工厂，

sentences.en: where steel workers have been manufacturing the Cadillac of steel bearings for nearly 60 years, strengthening the parts through a process known as heat treating.
sentences.zh: 那里的钢铁工人近 60 年来一直在制造钢铁轴承中的“凯迪拉克”，通过一种称为热处理的工艺来强化零件。

sentences.en: I've got to say I've never ran scrap the whole time I've been there.
sentences.zh: 我得说，我在那儿工作期间从来没出过废品。

sentences.en: You've never run scrap?
sentences.zh: 你从来没出过废品？

sentences.en: Okay, I guess that's kind of shop talk.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想这算是行话吧。

sentences.en: Scrap is like a bad part, like knowing that it's bad and you send it on through.
sentences.zh: 废品就像是不合格的零件，明知它不行却还是把它送了出去。

sentences.en: Shannon Mulcahy worked at Rexnerd for almost 18 years.
sentences.zh: 香农·穆尔卡希在雷克斯诺德工作了近 18 年。

sentences.en: In heat treat, it's got to be pretty much perfect.
sentences.zh: 在热处理环节，它必须做到近乎完美。

sentences.en: You know, we've got different customers that depend on that bearing and it can't fail out on the field.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们有不同的客户依赖这些轴承，它在现场绝不能出故障。

sentences.en: I mean, whether it be conveyor, a bridge, different things like that to hurt somebody out there on the field.
sentences.zh: 我是说，无论是传送带、桥梁还是其他类似的东西，都不能在现场伤到人。

sentences.en: And if you get that part, say you didn't temper it enough, okay, that will lead to the part cracking and breaking.
sentences.zh: 如果你拿到的那个零件，比如说回火不够，好吧，那会导致零件开裂和损坏。

sentences.en: Some of these are infrastructure that carry human beings back and forth.
sentences.zh: 其中一些基础设施是用来运送人类往返的。

sentences.en: It would seem pretty, pretty vital.
sentences.zh: 这看起来相当、相当重要。

sentences.en: I take pride in my work.
sentences.zh: 我为我的工作感到自豪。

sentences.en: Shannon is a 43-year-old single mother of two who dropped out of high school.
sentences.zh: 香农是一位 43 岁的单身母亲，有两个孩子，高中辍学。

sentences.en: My colleague Farrah Stockman has been reporting on the plant.
sentences.zh: 我的同事法拉·斯托克曼一直在报道这家工厂。

sentences.en: She was a legacy hire.
sentences.zh: 她是靠关系进来的。

sentences.en: My Uncle Gary got me a job on there.
sentences.zh: 我加里叔叔帮我找了份工作。

sentences.en: It started out as a janitor.
sentences.zh: 起初是做清洁工。

sentences.en: And at the time, you had to know someone to get a job at this factory.
sentences.zh: 当时，你得有熟人才能进这家工厂工作。

sentences.en: And so she begged him for a job?
sentences.zh: 所以她求他给份工作？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wasn't kind of like the janitor who cleans the bathrooMs.
sentences.zh: 那可不是那种打扫厕所的清洁工。

sentences.en: It was the janitor who shovels out the machine chips and the coolant, fill the coolant, pump out the machines of the coolant.
sentences.zh: 那是负责铲出机器碎屑和冷却液、加注冷却液、把冷却液从机器里抽出来的清洁工。

sentences.en: It was a nasty job.
sentences.zh: 那是一份很脏的活儿。

sentences.en: But I stuck with it.
sentences.zh: 但我坚持下来了。

sentences.en: I was actually working as an assembly at this time when I signed a heat treat job.
sentences.zh: 我签下热处理工作时，其实是在做装配工。

sentences.en: I was trained by what I call the old timers.
sentences.zh: 我是被我称之为“老前辈”的人带出来的。

sentences.en: The old timers would say, heat treat is not for a woman.
sentences.zh: 老前辈们会说，热处理不适合女人。

sentences.en: And they hazed her.
sentences.zh: 他们还欺负她。

sentences.en: They tried a lot of different ways to kind of get her to quit.
sentences.zh: 他们尝试了各种各样的方法想让她辞职。

sentences.en: And I'll be honest with you, I was ready to walk out of that department.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我当时真的准备离开那个部门了。

sentences.en: We was doing a light up on the furnaces, which that's the most dangerous part of your job.
sentences.zh: 我们当时正在点燃炉子，那是你工作中风险最高的部分。

sentences.en: To turn the furnace on.
sentences.zh: 打开炉子。

sentences.en: Yeah, to light the furnaces.
sentences.zh: 是的，点燃炉子。

sentences.en: And I was going, yep, yep, listening to him.
sentences.zh: 我当时在说，嗯，嗯，听着他的指挥。

sentences.en: He goes, now go over there and open that valve over there.
sentences.zh: 他说，现在过去把那个阀门打开。

sentences.en: And he didn't say open it slowly or anything.
sentences.zh: 他没说要慢慢打开什么的。

sentences.en: So I just went over there and I opened that valve and that son of a gun went boom.
sentences.zh: 所以我走过去打开了那个阀门，那个该死的玩意儿“砰”地一声炸了。

sentences.en: It scared the crap out of me.
sentences.zh: 吓死我了。

sentences.en: And I really was really thinking about leaving at that point.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我真的在考虑离开。

sentences.en: But I didn't.
sentences.zh: 但我没走。

sentences.en: I actually learned from them sabotaging better than anything, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我从他们的蓄意破坏中学到的东西比什么都多。

sentences.en: Because I had to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 因为我必须自己弄明白。

sentences.en: You got to go up these stairs.
sentences.zh: 你得爬上这些楼梯。

sentences.en: Then you got to go down the stairs to turn the machine on, which is on this panel.
sentences.zh: 然后你得走下楼梯去启动机器，就在这个面板上。

sentences.en: And Shannon got to know these machines really well.
sentences.zh: 香农对这些机器非常了解。

sentences.en: And she had personalities assigned to these machines.
sentences.zh: 她甚至给这些机器赋予了人格。

sentences.en: And her favorite one was the taco.
sentences.zh: 她最喜欢的那台叫“塔可”。

sentences.en: She talks about the taco like it's a needy boyfriend that breaks down whenever she doesn't spend time with it.
sentences.zh: 她谈起“塔可”时，就像在谈论一个粘人的男朋友，只要她不花时间陪它，它就会出故障。

sentences.en: Anybody was having problems and couldn't get it to run, I was sent over there to try to troubleshoot to get that thing to run.
sentences.zh: 任何人遇到问题搞不定的时候，我都会被派过去排查故障，让那东西运转起来。

sentences.en: She was essentially in charge of the furnaces there and working with dangerous gases, working with fire in a position that no woman had ever done before.
sentences.zh: 她基本上负责那里的炉子，处理危险气体，在火中工作，担任着从未有女性担任过的职位。

sentences.en: When I would do setups, you know, on the taco, like, I didn't have a CD player because of all the oil in the air and stuff.
sentences.zh: 当我在“塔可”上做设置时，你知道，因为空气中全是油之类的，我没法放 CD 机。

sentences.en: But sometimes when it would be so hot in there that music would take your mind off of how hot you really are in the heat treat.
sentences.zh: 但有时里面太热了，音乐能让你忘掉热处理车间里到底有多热。

sentences.en: Metallica, and then we got Bob Seger, Leonard Skinner.
sentences.zh: 金属乐队，还有鲍勃·西格、林纳·史金纳乐队。

sentences.en: It'd be like 125 degrees sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时温度能达到 125 华氏度（约 52 摄氏度）。

sentences.en: And she was known for being able to tell if the parts were going to come out right just by the sound of the spinning machine.
sentences.zh: 她以能通过旋转机器的声音判断零件是否合格而闻名。

sentences.en: Like when you're running a part, and it's going to sound stupid over this, but there's like a frequency sound, okay?
sentences.zh: 就像你在加工零件时，说出来可能听着很傻，但有一种频率的声音，明白吗？

sentences.en: And whereas some guys like to go back and look at the power supply and watch the numbers.
sentences.zh: 有些男人喜欢回头看电源，盯着数字看。

sentences.en: I don't do that.
sentences.zh: 我不那样做。

sentences.en: I just, I can tell by the sound.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我能听出声音。

sentences.en: The sound.
sentences.zh: 声音。

sentences.en: She could just hear from the pitch whether she needed to add energy or add heat.
sentences.zh: 她能通过音调听出是否需要增加能量或热量。

sentences.en: She just knew the machines that well that she could do it by feel.
sentences.zh: 她对机器的了解程度让她能凭感觉操作。

sentences.en: It's like a high-pitched tone.
sentences.zh: 那是一种高频音调。

sentences.en: It's very unique.
sentences.zh: 非常独特。

sentences.en: Nothing, I can't say anything sounds like it because it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 没什么，我没法说有什么声音像它，因为它就是独一无二的。

sentences.en: If it's got a really dull pitch, a really low, bogged down sound, I know that's not good.
sentences.zh: 如果声音很沉闷，很低沉，听起来很吃力，我就知道那不好。

sentences.en: And then if it's got a high pitch, I know it's good.
sentences.zh: 如果音调很高，我就知道那是好的。

sentences.en: This is a really detailed and involved process you're describing.
sentences.zh: 你描述的这个过程非常详细且复杂。

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: It takes experience.
sentences.zh: 这需要经验。

sentences.en: It's not something you can just train overnight, I will say that.
sentences.zh: 我得说，这不是一朝一夕就能训练出来的。

sentences.en: It takes experience.
sentences.zh: 这需要经验。

sentences.en: It takes time.
sentences.zh: 这需要时间。

sentences.en: So I really got this picture after spending so much time with Shannon of how she had really grown up in the factory.
sentences.zh: 在和香农相处了这么久之后，我真的勾勒出了她是如何在工厂里成长起来的画面。

sentences.en: She started at age 25 when she was this hot young thing that would turn heads on the factory floor.
sentences.zh: 她 25 岁开始工作，当时她是工厂里回头率极高的年轻辣妹。

sentences.en: And by the time she was 43, she was a woman who was used to having oil in her hands.
sentences.zh: 到了 43 岁，她成了一个习惯了手上沾满油污的女人。

sentences.en: She would come home and her kids would say, you smell like cars.
sentences.zh: 她回家时，孩子们会说，你闻起来像汽车。

sentences.en: You smell like a mechanic.
sentences.zh: 你闻起来像个修理工。

sentences.en: I guess that was just my style.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我的风格吧。

sentences.en: And I liked the fact that I didn't have to get up and put makeup on and all that stuff and try to look pretty to go to work.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那种不用起床化妆、不用为了上班打扮得漂漂亮亮的感觉。

sentences.en: I could roll out of bed and do my makeup there if I had to or not even wear makeup.
sentences.zh: 我可以从床上爬起来，如果需要的话就在那儿化妆，甚至不化妆也行。

sentences.en: So that's the part I like.
sentences.zh: 所以我喜欢这一点。

sentences.en: She became one of the best because she worked her way up from a janitor all the way to being a heat treat operator,
sentences.zh: 她成为了最优秀的人之一，因为她从清洁工一路做到了热处理操作员，

sentences.en: which was one of the highest paid positions on the factory floor.
sentences.zh: 这是工厂里薪水最高的职位之一。

sentences.en: I was paid $25, $16 an hour.
sentences.zh: 我当时的工资是每小时 25.16 美元。

sentences.en: I started out at $7.53 an hour when I started out there.
sentences.zh: 我刚开始在那里工作时，时薪是 7.53 美元。

sentences.en: And then I would say I would work 10 hours a day, five days a week, and then I'd work eight hours Saturday and Sunday.
sentences.zh: 然后我会说，我每天工作 10 小时，每周 5 天，周六和周日还要工作 8 小时。

sentences.en: And I would bring home a little over a grand a week.
sentences.zh: 我每周能带回家一千多美元。

sentences.en: Good money.
sentences.zh: 不错的收入。

sentences.en: Yes, it is good money.
sentences.zh: 是的，收入确实不错。

sentences.en: I mean, financially, this job was a big opportunity for you.
sentences.zh: 我是说，从经济上讲，这份工作对你来说是一个巨大的机会。

sentences.en: Very big opportunity for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说是非常大的机会。

sentences.en: Never would have dreamed, you know, that I was able to make that money and drive a nice car and not have to embarrass my daughter by taking her to school like my mom.
sentences.zh: 我做梦也没想到，我能赚到那些钱，开上一辆好车，不用像我妈那样送女儿上学时让她感到尴尬。

sentences.en: I hate to say it.
sentences.zh: 我不想这么说。

sentences.en: God bless her.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑她。

sentences.en: My mom was a single mother, and she didn't have a college degree or anything.
sentences.zh: 我妈是个单身母亲，她没有大学学位什么的。

sentences.en: She worked cleaning rooms and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 她靠打扫房间和在餐馆工作为生。

sentences.en: So we really never had anything, much of anything growing up as a kid.
sentences.zh: 所以我们小时候真的什么都没有，几乎一无所有。

sentences.en: I wouldn't even go to the store with my mom sometimes because I was embarrassed because she had to use food stamps.
sentences.zh: 我有时甚至不想和妈妈一起去商店，因为我很尴尬，她必须使用食品券。

sentences.en: And, I mean, I liked having that kind of money.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，我喜欢拥有那种钱的感觉。

sentences.en: I bought me a new car, a house.
sentences.zh: 我给自己买了辆新车，买了栋房子。

sentences.en: And I could go in and buy my groceries with money that I worked for.
sentences.zh: 我可以用我赚来的钱去买杂货。

sentences.en: You know, this job here, I'll be able to stand on my own two feet and be able to take care of myself and not depend on anybody.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这份工作让我能够自食其力，照顾好自己，而不依赖任何人。

sentences.en: You don't depend on no man.
sentences.zh: 你不依赖任何男人。

sentences.en: I mean, no offense, but you never know about men.
sentences.zh: 我是说，别介意，但你永远不知道男人会怎样。

sentences.en: I don't depend on them because you never know.
sentences.zh: 我不依赖他们，因为你永远不知道。

sentences.en: It sounds like men may have also disappointed you somehow.
sentences.zh: 听起来男人们可能也曾让你失望过。

sentences.en: I'll be honest with you there, yeah, all my life.
sentences.zh: 老实说，是的，我这辈子都是这样。

sentences.en: She was a domestic violence survivor, essentially.
sentences.zh: 她本质上是一位家庭暴力的幸存者。

sentences.en: And she basically was liberated by getting this job at this factory in a position that no woman had ever done before.
sentences.zh: 她通过在这家工厂获得了一个从未有女性担任过的职位，基本上获得了自由。

sentences.en: So, on October 14th, 2016.
I had just gotten to work.
sentences.zh: 我刚到公司。

sentences.en: She came in that Friday and.
sentences.zh: 那个周五她刚进来，然后。

sentences.en: My boss comes to me and says, Shannon, he said, I want you to shut everything down.
sentences.zh: 我的老板走过来对我说，香农，他说，我想让你把所有东西都关掉。

sentences.en: Put the furnaces in idle at 1500 degrees.
sentences.zh: 把炉子保持在 1500 度的待机状态。

sentences.en: Take the gas out.
sentences.zh: 把燃气关掉。

sentences.en: And he said, well, when you're done, just come to a meeting in the back dock.
sentences.zh: 他说，好了，做完之后，到后码头参加一个会议。

sentences.en: And I'm like, what?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，什么？

sentences.en: Are you serious?
sentences.zh: 你是认真的吗？

sentences.en: And he's like, yes, please.
sentences.zh: 他说，是的，拜托了。

sentences.en: By the time she was done, she started walking to the meeting and she could hear her co-workers yelling.
sentences.zh: 当她做完工作走去开会时，她能听到同事们的叫喊声。

sentences.en: And they were just told that the factory was closing and their jobs would move to a new plant in Mexico, Monterey, Mexico, and another facility in McAllen, Texas.
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚被告知工厂要关闭了，他们的工作岗位将转移到墨西哥蒙特雷的新工厂，以及德克萨斯州麦卡伦的另一家工厂。

sentences.en: I know that this is an incredibly tough message and you guys have a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是一个非常艰难的消息，你们肯定有很多疑问。

sentences.en: At this time, because we've just engaged and we've just invited the steel workers to start talking, I don't have any further information and I can't answer any questions.
sentences.zh: 目前，由于我们才刚刚接触，才刚刚邀请钢铁工人们开始对话，我没有任何进一步的消息，也无法回答任何问题。

sentences.en: And some of these workers had spent their whole lives in this plant.
sentences.zh: 而其中一些工人已经在该工厂工作了一辈子。

sentences.en: They were totally shocked, even though the company had been secretly planning this for years.
sentences.zh: 他们感到非常震惊，尽管公司多年来一直在秘密策划此事。

sentences.en: It's got to be a tough job to do that everywhere you go, huh?
sentences.zh: 无论走到哪里都要做这种事，一定很难受吧？

sentences.en: Oh, I mean, I made it to my car and I cried and cried and I just was thinking, what am I going to do?
sentences.zh: 噢，我是说，我回到车里哭个不停，我一直在想，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: Even though I made good money, I still worked paycheck to paycheck.
sentences.zh: 尽管我收入不错，但我依然是靠着每月的工资过活。

sentences.en: I didn't plan on saving any money for something like this to happen, you know?
sentences.zh: 我没打算存钱应对这种事，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I would have never thought.
sentences.zh: 我从未想过会这样。

sentences.en: And this was a really tough time for her because Shannon also had a daughter who was a high school senior who wanted to be the first in her family to go to college.
sentences.zh: 这对她来说是一段非常艰难的时期，因为香农还有一个读高三的女儿，她想成为家里第一个上大学的人。

sentences.en: And Shannon wanted to try to help her pay for it.
sentences.zh: 香农想尽力帮她支付学费。

sentences.en: I was freaking out, like, because I don't want her future to be ruined because I lost my job and unable to pay for her to go to college.
sentences.zh: 我当时快崩溃了，因为我不想因为我失业了，付不起她上大学的钱，就毁了她的未来。

sentences.en: And she also had a son who was really financially struggling, didn't have a job, depended on her financially.
sentences.zh: 她还有一个儿子，经济状况非常拮据，没有工作，在经济上依赖她。

sentences.en: And he had a four-year-old daughter who was disabled and they both depended on Shannon's paycheck.
sentences.zh: 他还有一个四岁的残疾女儿，他们俩都靠香农的工资生活。

sentences.en: She was the breadwinner of the house.
sentences.zh: 她是家里的顶梁柱。

sentences.en: I got to have a roof over her head and, you know, a decent place for her to live.
sentences.zh: 我得让她有瓦遮头，你知道的，得有个像样的住处。

sentences.en: You know, if it was just me, I mean, I could live on the street if I had to.
sentences.zh: 如果只是我一个人，我是说，如果非必要，我甚至可以睡在大街上。

sentences.en: I don't want to.
sentences.zh: 我不想那样。

sentences.en: That's all of that.
sentences.zh: 情况就是这样。

sentences.en: But, you know, it can happen that quick.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这种事发生得很快。

sentences.en: I just want to be sure I understand your financial and familial obligations at this point when you hear that your employer is going to be moving all these jobs to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我只是想确保我理解你目前的经济和家庭负担，当你听说雇主要把这些工作岗位全部转移到墨西哥时。

sentences.en: You have your house.
sentences.zh: 你有房子。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You have your car.
sentences.zh: 你有车。

sentences.en: You have a son who doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 你有一个不工作的儿子。

sentences.en: You have a daughter you're helping to support.
sentences.zh: 你有一个需要你资助的女儿。

sentences.en: And you have a quite sick granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 还有一个病得很重的孙女。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: As well as just yourself and everything that you need to do to take care of yourself.
sentences.zh: 以及你自己，还有你需要照顾自己所做的一切。

sentences.en: Am I missing anything?
sentences.zh: 我漏掉了什么吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: And my dogs.
sentences.zh: 还有我的狗。

sentences.en: The night that it happened, she drives home.
sentences.zh: 事情发生的那天晚上，她开车回家。

sentences.en: She's incredibly upset.
sentences.zh: 她非常难过。

sentences.en: And she writes on Facebook that she wishes that someone would burn the factory in Mexico to the ground.
sentences.zh: 她在脸书上写道，她希望有人能把墨西哥的那家工厂烧成平地。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: She was so upset.
sentences.zh: 她太难过了。

sentences.en: And she just didn't know what to do next.
sentences.zh: 她根本不知道接下来该怎么办。

sentences.en: She couldn't believe that it wasn't against the law.
sentences.zh: 她无法相信这竟然不违法。

sentences.en: How could this not be against the law to send people's jobs overseas?
sentences.zh: 把人们的工作岗位转移到海外，这怎么可能不违法呢？

sentences.en: What is going on?
sentences.zh: 到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: We are going to make this decision now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在要做出这个决定。

sentences.en: The Fox News decision desk has called Pennsylvania for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻决策台宣布唐纳德·特朗普赢下宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: And then a few weeks later, Donald Trump wins the election.
sentences.zh: 几周后，唐纳德·特朗普赢得了大选。

sentences.en: Donald J.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump is the president of the United States elect.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是美国当选总统。

sentences.en: He spoke to the disaffected.
sentences.zh: 他向那些心怀不满的人发表了讲话。

sentences.en: And she suddenly becomes hopeful that he's going to save her job.
sentences.zh: 她突然燃起了希望，觉得他能保住她的工作。

sentences.en: And she's not the only one.
sentences.zh: 而且她不是唯一一个这么想的人。

sentences.en: A lot of the co-workers at this factory felt like he was definitely going to save their job.
sentences.zh: 这家工厂里的许多同事都觉得他肯定能保住他们的工作。

sentences.en: Especially after Trump started tweeting about them.
sentences.zh: 特别是在特朗普开始发推特谈论他们之后。

sentences.en: The president tweeted about their company.
sentences.zh: 总统在推特上提到了他们的公司。

sentences.en: Yes.

sentences.en: You know, Rexnord is firing 300 workers.

sentences.en: No more.
sentences.zh: 到此为止。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Well, a tweet from President Donald Trump criticizes Indianapolis manufacturer Rexnord for moving a plant and jobs to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 嗯，唐纳德·特朗普总统的一条推文批评了印第安纳波利斯的制造商雷克斯诺德公司，称其将工厂和工作岗位转移到墨西哥。

sentences.en: An Indiana company's decision to move to Mexico is getting renewed attention tonight from President Trump.
sentences.zh: 一家印第安纳州公司迁往墨西哥的决定今晚再次受到特朗普总统的关注。

sentences.en: He tweeted this evening that...
sentences.zh: 他今晚发推文说……

sentences.en: It said, Rexnord of Indiana is moving to Mexico and rather viciously firing all of its 300 workers.
sentences.zh: 推文写道，印第安纳州的雷克斯诺德公司正在迁往墨西哥，并极其恶劣地解雇了其全部300名工人。

sentences.en: This is happening all over our country.
sentences.zh: 这种情况正在我们全国各地发生。

sentences.en: No more.
sentences.zh: 到此为止。

sentences.en: I thought, well, wow, he does notice us people that's down here, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想，哇，他确实注意到了我们这些底层的人，你知道吗。

sentences.en: And they spent hours debating, like, what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 他们花了几个小时争论，这到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: No more.
sentences.zh: 到此为止。

sentences.en: No more including Rexnord?
sentences.zh: 到此为止包括雷克斯诺德吗？

sentences.en: Or is Rexnord included in the no more?
sentences.zh: 还是说雷克斯诺德被包含在“到此为止”里了？

sentences.en: But a lot of them really took it as a sign of hope.
sentences.zh: 但他们中的许多人真的把它视为一种希望的信号。

sentences.en: He's going to save this factory.
sentences.zh: 他会拯救这家工厂的。

sentences.en: I was very hopeful.
sentences.zh: 我当时充满希望。

sentences.en: All of us were hopeful.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都充满希望。

sentences.en: A lot of us there at Rexnord was thinking that he might step in and stop what was going on, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们在雷克斯诺德的很多人都认为他可能会介入并阻止正在发生的事情，你知道的。

sentences.en: So you believed that Trump could potentially save his job?
sentences.zh: 所以你相信特朗普有可能保住他的工作？

sentences.en: I mean, he's a president.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他是总统。

sentences.en: Why couldn't he?
sentences.zh: 为什么不能呢？

sentences.en: He can do whatever he wants, right?
sentences.zh: 他想做什么就能做什么，对吧？

sentences.en: To the point, I mean, I just kind of thought, you know, because he's kind of like a cowboy.
sentences.zh: 甚至可以说，我只是觉得，你知道，因为他有点像个牛仔。

sentences.en: He says things probably like a lot of past presidents wouldn't save.
sentences.zh: 他说话的方式可能很多前任总统都不会说。

sentences.en: So, I mean, the way he talked about American jobs and all that, I was thinking, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，他谈论美国就业机会的方式，我当时在想，你知道，

sentences.en: this could be the opportunity where he's right that, you know, a lot of our jobs might come back from overseas and things like that.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个机会，他说得对，你知道，我们很多工作岗位可能会从海外回流，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And a lot of people get their jobs back.
sentences.zh: 很多人能拿回他们的工作。

sentences.en: That would be awesome.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: She voted for Obama in 2008?
sentences.zh: 她在2008年投给了奥巴马？

sentences.en: I did vote for Obama.
sentences.zh: 我确实投给了奥巴马。

sentences.en: And I do still to this day say that Obama is a good president, was a good president.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我仍然说奥巴马是一位好总统，曾经是一位好总统。

sentences.en: And, you know, I wish he could be there again.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我希望他能再次担任总统。

sentences.en: She liked what he did for health care.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢他在医疗保健方面所做的事情。

sentences.en: And she thought about voting for Hillary because Hillary talked about the Family and Medical Leave Act, which is something that Shannon had used when her granddaughter got sick.
sentences.zh: 她曾考虑投票给希拉里，因为希拉里谈到了《家庭与医疗休假法》，这是香农在孙女病重时使用过的法律。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, the job was the most important thing for Shannon.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，工作对香农来说是最重要的事情。

sentences.en: It was her entire life.
sentences.zh: 那是她的整个人生。

sentences.en: It was her identity.
sentences.zh: 那是她的身份。

sentences.en: The other things were, you know, they were luxuries.
sentences.zh: 其他事情，你知道，都是奢侈品。

sentences.en: They were a social safety net that she didn't want to have to need.
sentences.zh: 那是她不想依赖的社会安全网。

sentences.en: So she was on social media supporting Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以她在社交媒体上支持特朗普。

sentences.en: She would tweet to him.
sentences.zh: 她会给他发推特。

sentences.en: Anytime you tweet about Rex Nord, she tweeted back.
sentences.zh: 每当他发推特提到雷克斯诺德时，她都会回复。

sentences.en: He was all over her Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 他的身影充斥着她的脸书页面。

sentences.en: She felt like he did care about people like her and spoke her language.
sentences.zh: 她觉得他确实关心像她这样的人，并且说着她的语言。

sentences.en: So she got really excited and thought that maybe they would have a chance, that he would swoop in and save them.
sentences.zh: 所以她非常兴奋，认为也许他们会有机会，他会突然介入并拯救他们。

sentences.en: I assume this isn't all for me.
sentences.zh: 我想这些不全是给我的吧。

sentences.en: First of all, welcome to Carrier Indianapolis.
sentences.zh: 首先，欢迎来到印第安纳波利斯的开利工厂。

sentences.en: Listen, it's an honor to welcome President-elect Trump, as well as Vice President-elect Pence and the new governor, Governor Holcomb from Indiana today.
sentences.zh: 听着，今天能欢迎当选总统特朗普，以及当选副总统彭斯和印第安纳州新任州长霍尔科姆，我深感荣幸。

sentences.en: A couple weeks after Trump wins, he comes to Indianapolis and announces this deal to save some jobs at a plant called Carrier.
sentences.zh: 特朗普胜选几周后，他来到印第安纳波利斯，宣布了一项拯救开利工厂部分就业岗位的协议。

sentences.en: And, in fact, it's the same union.
sentences.zh: 而且，事实上，这是同一个工会。

sentences.en: And the president-elect of the United States of America, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 美利坚合众国当选总统，唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: So the people at the Rex Nord plant get their hopes up even more.
sentences.zh: 所以雷克斯诺德工厂的人们更加充满希望了。

sentences.en: And you can see on their Facebook pages, a lot of them are like, he gets results.
sentences.zh: 你可以在他们的脸书页面上看到，很多人都在说，他能带来成果。

sentences.en: It's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这一定会实现的。

sentences.en: You have to understand, we can't allow this to happen anymore with our country.
sentences.zh: 你必须明白，我们不能再允许这种事情在我们的国家发生了。

sentences.en: So many jobs are leaving and going to other countries, not just Mexico, many, many countries.
sentences.zh: 太多的工作岗位正在流失到其他国家，不仅仅是墨西哥，还有很多很多国家。

sentences.en: But we're losing companies.
sentences.zh: 但我们正在失去公司。

sentences.en: It's unbelievable, one after another, just one after another.
sentences.zh: 这简直不可思议，一个接一个，就是一个接一个。

sentences.en: We're going to have a lot of phone calls made to companies when they say they're thinking about leaving this country because they're not leaving this country.
sentences.zh: 当公司说他们考虑离开这个国家时，我们会给他们打很多电话，因为他们不能离开这个国家。

sentences.en: They're not going to leave this country.
sentences.zh: 他们不会离开这个国家。

sentences.en: And the workers are going to keep their jobs.
sentences.zh: 工人们会保住他们的工作。

sentences.en: And they can leave from state to state.
sentences.zh: 他们可以在各州之间搬迁。

sentences.en: And they can negotiate good deals with the different states and all of that.
sentences.zh: 他们可以与不同的州协商达成好的协议，诸如此类。

sentences.en: But leaving the country is going to be very, very difficult.
sentences.zh: 但离开这个国家将会非常、非常困难。

sentences.en: So they get even more excited.
sentences.zh: 所以他们变得更加兴奋了。

sentences.en: But the company keeps pressing forward with its plans.
sentences.zh: 但公司继续推进其计划。

sentences.en: And you see a letter from the CEO hanging on the bulletin board saying, nope, we're moving.
sentences.zh: 你看到公告栏上贴着首席执行官的一封信，上面写着，不，我们要搬走。

sentences.en: And we're going to bring Mexican trainees into the plant in the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们将在未来几周内把墨西哥的实习生带进工厂。

sentences.en: And we want you to train your replacements.
sentences.zh: 我们要你们培训你们的替代者。

sentences.en: And if you don't, you're not going to get a severance package.
sentences.zh: 如果不培训，你们就拿不到遣散费。

sentences.en: So every single worker on that factory floor was faced with a decision of, do I train my replacement or do I refuse?
sentences.zh: 所以工厂车间的每一位工人都面临着一个决定：我是培训我的替代者，还是拒绝？

sentences.en: And there was a huge divide between the ones who decided to train their replacements and the ones who stood up and said no.
sentences.zh: 决定培训替代者的人和站出来说“不”的人之间产生了巨大的分歧。

sentences.en: To see what's going on across this entire country is disgusting.
sentences.zh: 看到全国各地正在发生的事情，真是令人作呕。

sentences.en: It's disgusting.
sentences.zh: 真是令人作呕。

sentences.en: It's nothing but corporate greed.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是企业贪婪。

sentences.en: We all know that.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道这一点。

sentences.en: That's what we're talking about today is corporate greed.
sentences.zh: 我们今天谈论的就是企业贪婪。

sentences.en: If you don't train, this company's screwed.
sentences.zh: 如果你不培训，这家公司就完蛋了。

sentences.en: They have to have us to train.
sentences.zh: 他们必须有我们来培训。

sentences.zh: 如果我们像工会要求的那样团结一致，他们就完蛋了。

sentences.en: They don't have anybody to teach them anything.
sentences.zh: 他们没有人可以教他们任何东西。

sentences.zh: 许多工会代表，包括工会本身，都极力鼓励人们不要培训他们的替代者。

sentences.en: And they couldn't train the Mexican replacements.
sentences.zh: 他们无法培训墨西哥的替代者。

sentences.en: So they needed those workers to pass that knowledge on.
sentences.zh: 所以他们需要这些工人来传承那些知识。

sentences.zh: 而工人们也心知肚明。

sentences.zh: 只有我的同事们掌握那些知识。

sentences.en: Do you know anybody who agreed to train?
sentences.zh: 你认识同意参加培训的人吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然认识。

sentences.en: My guy on the date ship that I followed agreed to train.
sentences.zh: 我跟踪报道的那位负责日期打印机的员工就同意了培训。

sentences.en: Talk to him every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都跟他交谈。

sentences.en: What do you think about it?
sentences.zh: 你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: I think they're scabs.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们是工贼。

sentences.en: Just to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 老实跟你说吧。

sentences.en: It's no different if we were out on strike and you cross the picket line in my eyes.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这和我们罢工时你越过纠察线没什么两样。

sentences.en: It was a very divisive time.
sentences.zh: 那是一段非常分裂的时期。

sentences.en: Friendships ended.
sentences.zh: 友谊破裂了。

sentences.en: People stopped speaking to each other.
sentences.zh: 人们不再和彼此说话。

sentences.en: I didn't want to go verbally attack.
sentences.zh: 我不想去进行言语攻击。

sentences.en: Emotions were high.
sentences.zh: 当时情绪非常激动。

sentences.en: I didn't want to go verbally just attack him and assault him.
sentences.zh: 我不想去对他进行言语攻击或人身攻击。

sentences.en: And so I let a couple of days go by.
sentences.zh: 所以我让事情冷却了几天。

sentences.en: And I just basically said, man, I can't believe you're going to do that.
sentences.zh: 然后我基本上就是说，伙计，真不敢相信你会这么做。

sentences.en: You know, you're selling us all out.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你这是在出卖我们所有人。

sentences.en: One guy walked out of the factory and quit when he heard that his friend had signed up to train.
sentences.zh: 有个人听说朋友报名参加培训后，直接走出工厂辞职了。

sentences.en: He just walked out and ended his own career there.
sentences.zh: 他直接走人，结束了自己在那里的一切职业生涯。

sentences.en: Walked away from severance, walked away from everything and quit.
sentences.zh: 放弃了遣散费，放弃了一切，直接辞职了。

sentences.en: He left like more than $10,000 in severance.
sentences.zh: 他放弃了超过一万美元的遣散费。

sentences.en: And I later talked to him and he said, yeah, it's just depressing to see that you ain't got a future.
sentences.zh: 后来我跟他聊过，他说，是啊，看到自己没有未来，真的很令人沮丧。

sentences.en: You know, we talk a lot in this country about the white working class.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这个国家，我们经常谈论白人蓝领阶层。

sentences.en: The working class, we talk about it like it's white.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论工人阶级时，就好像他们都是白人一样。

sentences.en: But in fact, the working class is not white.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，工人阶级并非全是白人。

sentences.en: There's a lot of black people in the working class.
sentences.zh: 工人阶级中有很多黑人。

sentences.en: And this factory was about 40 percent black.
sentences.zh: 而这家工厂里大约有40%是黑人。

sentences.en: And from what I could tell, people really got along.
sentences.zh: 据我观察，大家相处得真的很融洽。

sentences.en: They were on the bowling team together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起参加保龄球队。

sentences.en: They went to Colts games together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起去看小马队的比赛。

sentences.en: They ate dinner at each other's houses.
sentences.zh: 他们去彼此家里吃晚饭。

sentences.en: There were at least two romances that I knew of that were interracial.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，至少有两段跨种族恋情。

sentences.en: It was a very interracial factory.
sentences.zh: 那是一家非常多元化的工厂。

sentences.en: But I noticed a pattern.
sentences.zh: 但我注意到一个模式。

sentences.en: A lot of the people who were so upset about the closing, the people who walked out without their severance or the people who went on television and talked about how they felt like
sentences.zh: 很多对工厂倒闭感到非常难过的人，那些放弃遣散费直接走人的人，或者那些上电视讲述自己感受的人，他们……

sentences.en: nothing.
sentences.zh: 一无所有。

sentences.en: They were so outraged by this.
sentences.zh: 他们对此感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: They were white.
sentences.zh: 他们是白人。

sentences.en: And when you talk to the black workers, so many of them made the decision to train right away from the beginning and with no shame.
sentences.zh: 而当你和黑人工人交谈时，他们中很多人从一开始就决定参加培训，而且毫无愧疚感。

sentences.en: They just raised their hands.
sentences.zh: 他们只是举了手。

sentences.en: They said, I'm going to get that money.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我要拿到那笔钱。

sentences.en: We can't change this decision.
sentences.zh: 我们无法改变这个决定。

sentences.en: We can't stop it.
sentences.zh: 我们无法阻止它。

sentences.en: Let's just agree to train and get that money.
sentences.zh: 我们还是同意培训并拿到那笔钱吧。

sentences.en: Farrah, how do you account for the grievances of the white worker and their unwillingness
sentences.zh: 法拉，你如何解释白人工人的不满，以及他们不愿

sentences.en: to train the Mexican workers versus the general willingness of the black workers in the factory to participate in that?
sentences.zh: 培训墨西哥工人，而工厂里的黑人工人却普遍愿意参与其中？

sentences.en: You can see a lot of studies, nationwide studies, about the American dream and optimism.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到很多关于美国梦和乐观主义的全国性研究。

sentences.en: And you'll find that working class whites are very pessimistic about the future.
sentences.zh: 你会发现白人蓝领阶层对未来非常悲观。

sentences.en: They don't believe the future is going to be better than the past because they've seen their economic prospects decline for 30 years.
sentences.zh: 他们不相信未来会比过去更好，因为他们已经目睹自己的经济前景衰退了30年。

sentences.en: You know, in the 60s, that factory was probably all white men.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在60年代，那家工厂可能全是白人男性。

sentences.en: And in order to get a job there, you had to pretty much know someone in there.
sentences.zh: 而且为了在那里得到一份工作，你几乎必须认识里面的人。

sentences.en: So they had like a monopoly on all those jobs.
sentences.zh: 所以他们垄断了所有这些工作岗位。

sentences.en: And then over time, you see their monopoly on the job disappears.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，你会发现他们对工作的垄断消失了。

sentences.en: There's no denying that the economic prospects of a white guy without a college degree has declined pretty dramatically over the last three years.
sentences.zh: 不可否认，过去三年里，没有大学学位的白人男性的经济前景急剧下滑。

sentences.en: Whereas everybody else have still seen an upward climb because they started from such a low place.
sentences.zh: 而其他人却仍在攀升，因为他们的起点太低了。

sentences.en: And so I think when you talk to black workers, one, they didn't feel entitled to the job.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，当你和黑人工人交谈时，第一，他们并不觉得这份工作是理所应当的。

sentences.en: And two, they thought, well, we're used to it.
sentences.zh: 第二，他们会想，好吧，我们习惯了。

sentences.en: We're used to bad things happening to us.
sentences.zh: 我们习惯了坏事发生在自己身上。

sentences.en: And three, I think they still feel like the best days are ahead.
sentences.zh: 第三，我认为他们仍然觉得最好的日子还在后头。

sentences.en: What about the women in the factory?
sentences.zh: 工厂里的女性情况如何？

sentences.en: I mean, I think the women were also more willing to volunteer to train.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为女性也更愿意主动报名参加培训。

sentences.en: Maybe they needed the money more, or maybe they remembered what it was like when people didn't want to train them.
sentences.zh: 也许她们更需要钱，或者她们还记得当初别人不想培训她们时的情景。

sentences.en: I stopped and I thought about it, you know.
sentences.zh: 我停下来思考了一下，你知道。

sentences.en: Shannon's granddaughter had spent months in a coma that year.
sentences.zh: 那一年，香农的孙女在昏迷中度过了好几个月。

sentences.en: She had lost all her fingers.
sentences.zh: 她失去了所有的手指。

sentences.en: Somehow the cannula punctured through her heart.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，套管刺穿了她的心脏。

sentences.en: So she had went into cardiac arreSt.
sentences.zh: 所以她心脏骤停了。

sentences.en: She has a scar on her cheSt.
sentences.zh: 她的胸口有一道伤疤。

sentences.en: I took my eyeliner and I traced the scar around her chest and it looks just like an angel wings.
sentences.zh: 我用眼线笔沿着她胸口的伤疤描了一圈，看起来就像天使的翅膀。

sentences.en: Right on the front.
sentences.zh: 就在正前方。

sentences.en: Because she had like four open heart surgeries that week.
sentences.zh: 因为那周她做了四次开胸手术。

sentences.en: She doesn't walk anymore.
sentences.zh: 她再也不能走路了。

sentences.en: She don't talk anymore.
sentences.zh: 她再也不能说话了。

sentences.en: She has a trach.
sentences.zh: 她做了气管切开术。

sentences.en: She lost all of her fingers on her right hand.
sentences.zh: 她右手的所有手指都没了。

sentences.en: And she lost all the tips of her finger on her.
sentences.zh: 她所有手指的指尖也都失去了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But I'll tell you what.
sentences.zh: 但我告诉你。

sentences.en: She's a fighter because she's still here and she's a happy little baby.
sentences.zh: 她是个斗士，因为她还在这里，而且是个快乐的小宝贝。

sentences.en: She goes through a lot.
sentences.zh: 她经历了很多。

sentences.en: I always think, you know, things could be worse.
sentences.zh: 我总是想，你知道，情况可能会更糟。

sentences.en: What is your granddaughter's name?
sentences.zh: 你孙女叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Carmela.
sentences.zh: 卡梅拉。

sentences.en: Carmela Linda Marie Roberts.
sentences.zh: 卡梅拉·琳达·玛丽·罗伯茨。
zh_words: 卡梅拉·琳达·玛丽·罗伯茨

sentences.en: So Shannon really has a lot on her shoulders this year.
sentences.zh: 所以香农今年真的肩负着沉重的压力。

sentences.en: And she really thought, well, I need this money.
sentences.zh: 她真的想，好吧，我需要这笔钱。

sentences.en: I need this money to take care of my family.
sentences.zh: 我需要这笔钱来照顾我的家人。

sentences.en: And I'm going to take every dime I can get.
sentences.zh: 我要拿到我能拿到的每一分钱。

sentences.en: And that's what's important here.
sentences.zh: 这才是这里最重要的事。

sentences.en: That's what the main goal is here.
sentences.zh: 这才是这里的主要目标。

sentences.en: It's all about that dollar bill.
sentences.zh: 一切都是为了那张美钞。

sentences.en: That mighty dollar bill.
sentences.zh: 那张万能的美钞。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to make it while I can make it because I'll never have a chance again to probably make that again.
sentences.zh: 我趁现在能赚就赚，因为我可能再也没有机会赚到这些钱了。

sentences.en: So ultimately, she decided to do the training.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，她决定参加培训。

sentences.en: So when did the Mexican workers first arrive?
sentences.zh: 那么墨西哥工人是什么时候开始到达的？

sentences.en: So right around Christmas time, the first group comes.
sentences.zh: 就在圣诞节前后，第一批人来了。

sentences.en: And when they walk in the plant, some people freeze.
sentences.zh: 当他们走进工厂时，有些人僵住了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I just we just looked at them.
sentences.zh: 我只是……我们只是看着他们。

sentences.en: You know, everybody would be like, you know, the Mexican workers are here.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每个人都会说，你知道，墨西哥工人来了。

sentences.en: You see them walk by in a group and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 你看着他们成群结队地走过之类的。

sentences.en: And how did Shannon approach the Mexican workers?
sentences.zh: 香农是如何对待墨西哥工人的？

sentences.en: Did she resent them?
sentences.zh: 她怨恨他们吗？

sentences.en: Did she embrace them?
sentences.zh: 她接纳他们了吗？

sentences.en: I think once they came, she really pretty quickly formed a bond with them.
sentences.zh: 我想一旦他们来了，她很快就和他们建立了联系。

sentences.en: She took one young Mexican trainee under her wing and really decided to train him the way that she'd been trained pretty much.
sentences.zh: 她把一名年轻的墨西哥学员带在身边，并决定按照她受训的方式来培训他。

sentences.en: I think I mother-in him kind of like he was just like, he's my son's age.
sentences.zh: 我想我像对待孩子一样照顾他，他和我儿子差不多大。

sentences.en: He's a good kid.
sentences.zh: 他是个好孩子。

sentences.en: You know, she could have just done the minimum.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她本可以只做最基本的工作。

sentences.en: She could have just answered a few questions.
sentences.zh: 她本可以只回答几个问题。

sentences.en: But she wanted him to know the job and she trained him the way that she was trained.
sentences.zh: 但她想让他学会这份工作，于是她按照自己受训的方式培训了他。

sentences.en: So she's passing on this knowledge.
sentences.zh: 所以她在传承这些知识。

sentences.en: And that knowledge is really all these workers have, right?
sentences.zh: 而这些知识确实是这些工人所拥有的全部，对吧？

sentences.en: It's what makes them valuable as people in their minds and I guess in the factory itself.
sentences.zh: 在他们心中，甚至在工厂本身看来，这才是让他们有价值的东西。

sentences.en: Tad, I call him Tad because I never could really say his name right.
sentences.zh: 泰德，我叫他泰德，因为我从来没法正确念出他的名字。

sentences.en: After I trained him, he'd go to lunch and he would come back and he brought me a cookie from his lunch.
sentences.zh: 我培训完他后，他去吃午饭，回来时带了一块午餐里的饼干给我。

sentences.en: You know, and he says, my friend tells me that, you know, a lot of your people here doesn't like us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他说，我的朋友告诉我，你们这里很多人不喜欢我们。

sentences.en: He says, I didn't know that I'm taking your job.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不知道我是在抢你的工作。

sentences.en: I am so sorry that I, and I said, no.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉，我说，不。

sentences.en: I said, don't be sorry.
sentences.zh: 我说，别道歉。

sentences.en: I said, it's corporate greed.
sentences.zh: 我说，这是企业的贪婪。

sentences.en: I said, just, I'm glad that you were able to have that opportunity like I was able to have that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我说，我很高兴你能像我一样获得这个机会。

sentences.en: I could tell from the heart.
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到他是发自内心的。

sentences.en: He was very sincere about how he felt bad.
sentences.zh: 他对自己感到难过是非常真诚的。

sentences.en: That he did not know.
sentences.zh: 他什么都不知道。

sentences.en: No one told them.
sentences.zh: 没人告诉他们。

sentences.en: No one told them.
sentences.zh: 没人告诉他们。

sentences.en: And so Shannon tried to be super nice and super upbeat with them, but she would never leave them alone in the factory.
sentences.zh: 所以香农尽量对他们表现得非常友好和乐观，但她从不让他们独自待在工厂里。

sentences.en: She took them everywhere she went.
sentences.zh: 她去哪儿都带着他们。

sentences.en: Because she feared something might happen to them?
sentences.zh: 因为她担心他们会出事吗？

sentences.en: I mean, she didn't say it in so many words, but she didn't want anything to happen to them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她没有明说，但她不想让他们出任何事。

sentences.en: So she protected them?
sentences.zh: 所以她在保护他们？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Did she say why she did that?
sentences.zh: 她有说为什么要这么做吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I think all of the trainers ended up really seeing their trainees as human beings and seeing themselves in this other person.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为所有的培训师最终都真正把学员看作人，并在对方身上看到了自己。

sentences.en: Very respectful.
sentences.zh: 非常尊重。

sentences.en: Very nice.
sentences.zh: 非常友善。

sentences.en: Very much so like me, you know.
sentences.zh: 非常像我，你知道。

sentences.en: So what happens in the summer, Farrah?
sentences.zh: 那么夏天发生了什么，法拉？

sentences.en: So in August, the last time I went to Indianapolis was the sort of the culmination of all of this.
sentences.zh: 八月份，我最后一次去印第安纳波利斯，那是这一切的终点。

sentences.en: Her daughter goes off to college.
sentences.zh: 她的女儿要去上大学了。

sentences.en: She drops her daughter off at college.
sentences.zh: 她送女儿去上大学。

sentences.en: And then the next day she goes into the factory and they're disconnecting her favorite machine, the taco.
sentences.zh: 第二天她去工厂，他们正在拆除她最喜欢的机器，那台塔科机。

sentences.en: One of the Mexican team is there and they're taking it away from her.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥团队里有人在那儿，他们正把东西从她手里拿走。

sentences.en: And I had to turn around and walk outside so that everybody didn't see me crying.
sentences.zh: 我不得不转过身走到外面，免得大家看到我在哭。

sentences.en: And it was upsetting.
sentences.zh: 那真的很让人难过。

sentences.en: Very.
sentences.zh: 非常难过。

sentences.en: So because I was feeling like everything even now.
sentences.zh: 因为我感觉就像……即使是现在也是这样。

sentences.en: It's very upsetting because it's like everything is gone.
sentences.zh: 这非常令人难过，因为感觉一切都没了。

sentences.en: And there's nothing I can do about it.
sentences.zh: 而我对此无能为力。

sentences.en: Just get up and keep going.
sentences.zh: 只能振作起来，继续生活。

sentences.en: Hold on, Carrie.
sentences.zh: 坚持住，嘉莉。

sentences.en: It seemed like a pretty poignant moment.
sentences.zh: 那似乎是一个相当令人心酸的时刻。

sentences.en: I believe it was actually caught on video of where you were in this kind of empty factory.
sentences.zh: 我相信当时确实拍到了视频，你当时就在那个空荡荡的工厂里。

sentences.en: What was, at this point, what does it look like inside the factory?
sentences.zh: 工厂内部现在看起来是什么样子的？

sentences.en: How many machines are left?
sentences.zh: 还剩下多少机器？

sentences.en: What is it starting to look like?
sentences.zh: 现在看起来像什么样？

sentences.en: It looks like a ghost factory.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像一座鬼工厂。

sentences.en: The factory was so empty that I was able to ride our bicycle off trail, shall I say, ride all around the factory on the bicycle because there was nothing left.
sentences.zh: 工厂空得我都能骑着自行车在里面到处转，可以说是在工厂里骑车兜风，因为什么都不剩了。

sentences.en: That's how it looks.
sentences.zh: 看起来就是那样。

sentences.en: There's nothing left.
sentences.zh: 什么都没剩下。

sentences.en: At what point did it dawn on you that the president, that nobody, but especially that the president, couldn't do anything about this or wouldn't or to save the jobs?
sentences.zh: 你是在什么时候意识到总统，或者说没有人，尤其是总统，对此无能为力，或者说他根本不想拯救这些工作岗位的？

sentences.en: I don't know if he just couldn't or he just wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是真的做不到，还是根本不想做。

sentences.en: I felt kind of let down, shall I say, you know.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己被辜负了，可以这么说吧，你知道的。

sentences.en: I think he just said that just because of his campaign.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他当时那么说只是为了竞选。

sentences.en: Then after he's got in there, then he done forgot about us.
sentences.zh: 等他当选之后，就把我们抛之脑后了。

sentences.en: We don't matter anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们不再重要了。

sentences.en: You know, oh, he's going to raise the tariff and all this other stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他说什么要提高关税之类的。

sentences.en: Well, why wouldn't you have done it or try to tell them?
sentences.zh: 那么，你为什么不去做，或者试着去告诉他们呢？

sentences.en: I don't know what they do, but, you know, he's got other things to tend to.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们在做什么，但你知道，他还有别的事情要处理。

sentences.en: We're not, I don't think that we're part of his agenda anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们不再是他议程的一部分了，我不觉得我们还是。

sentences.en: That's obvious.
sentences.zh: 显而易见。

sentences.en: Shannon's last day was two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 香农的最后一天是两周前。

sentences.en: I have to keep my keys in this way.
sentences.zh: 我得这样保管我的钥匙。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: When it comes to doing my last, loading the furnace for the last time, it didn't hit me till then.
sentences.zh: 当最后一次装炉时，直到那一刻我才真正意识到这一切。

sentences.en: Things are just totally different.
sentences.zh: 一切都完全不同了。

sentences.en: I'm trying to get adjusted and not feel so worthless.
sentences.zh: 我正在努力适应，不想让自己感觉那么没用。

sentences.en: I know I'm not worthless, but I feel worthless.
sentences.zh: 我知道我不是没用，但我感觉自己很没用。

sentences.en: Why do you feel worthless?
sentences.zh: 为什么你会觉得没用？

sentences.en: Because I feel like, I don't feel as good about it as feeling secure to be able to support my family.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得，我无法再像以前那样有安全感去供养我的家庭了。

sentences.en: That's why.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: How they can just up and rip it away from you is just wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们怎么能就这样突然把一切从你手中夺走，这太不对了。

sentences.en: I mean, I can see, like I said, if we wasn't making any money or we was doing such a poor job,
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果是因为我们没赚到钱，或者工作做得太差，我还能理解，

sentences.en: but the bottom line is when you're doing a good job and they even tell you you're doing a good job and they turn around and just throw you to the side like you're nothing,
sentences.zh: 但关键是，当你工作表现出色，他们甚至亲口夸你做得好，转头却把你像垃圾一样扔到一边，

sentences.en: it's very hard to take and to swallow, you know, you know.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难接受，很难咽下这口气，你知道的。

sentences.en: And it's like, I'm not that marketable out there.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉我在外面也没什么竞争力。

sentences.en: Who's going to want an old woman now, you know?
sentences.zh: 现在谁还会想要一个老女人呢，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I think it's just been a roller coaster seven months.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这七个月就像坐过山车一样。

sentences.en: And I think now that it's over, she's finally got to sit down and look at her life and decide what she does next.
sentences.zh: 我想现在一切都结束了，她终于可以坐下来审视自己的生活，决定下一步该做什么。

sentences.en: Who does she become now that she's no longer the heat treat operator at the sparing factory?
sentences.zh: 当她不再是斯帕林工厂的热处理操作员时，她现在成了谁？

sentences.en: I lived and I breathed my job.
sentences.zh: 我为工作而活，为工作而呼吸。

sentences.en: I was in there a lot of times, seven days a week for a lot of years.
sentences.zh: 很多年来，我经常一周七天都在那里。

sentences.en: And I am grateful that my uncle got me that job.
sentences.zh: 我很感激我叔叔帮我找到了那份工作。

sentences.en: I am grateful and thankful that I was able to have that job.
sentences.zh: 我很感激，也很庆幸我能拥有那份工作。

sentences.en: Because a lot of people don't look out that way because I didn't have a college degree.
sentences.zh: 因为很多人并不看好，毕竟我没有大学学位。

sentences.en: But, you know, I made as much money probably as some of the college degree people do, you know.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，我赚的钱可能和一些有大学学位的人一样多。

sentences.en: And, you know, because we get interns that come in over there and they wouldn't know anything.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，因为我们那边来的实习生什么都不懂。

sentences.en: But they have a lot of years of college.
sentences.zh: 但他们读了很多年大学。

sentences.en: But so that's where I guess they knew more than me, but not really when it comes to running the parts.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在理论上他们比我懂得多，但在实际操作零件时却并非如此。

sentences.en: The Rexner factory was originally slated to close in April, but that was delayed until September because the new plants were taking longer than expected to get up to speed.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯纳工厂原定于四月关闭，但推迟到了九月，因为新工厂的投产速度比预期的要慢。

sentences.en: Shannon's daughter, Nicole, just started as a freshman at Purdue University, where she's planning to study nursing.
sentences.zh: 香农的女儿妮可刚开始在普渡大学读大一，她打算学习护理。

sentences.en: She was awarded more than $30,000 in scholarships to cover her tuition.
sentences.zh: 她获得了超过三万美元的奖学金来支付学费。

sentences.en: I'm going to move this out.
sentences.zh: 我要把这个移开。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Because see, this is Carmella's area here.
sentences.zh: 因为你看，这是卡梅拉的地方。

sentences.en: Get this all where she can get on the floor and play.
sentences.zh: 把这里收拾好，让她可以在地板上玩耍。

sentences.en: A couple of weeks ago, Farrah Stockman went back to Indianapolis to visit Shannon in her home.
sentences.zh: 几周前，法拉·斯托克曼回到印第安纳波利斯，去香农家里拜访了她。

sentences.en: Yeah, I want to say hi.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我想打个招呼。

sentences.en: But you've got to show us your cards.
sentences.zh: 但你得给我们看看你的卡片。

sentences.en: She told Farrah that she received several messages and cards after her story came out in the Times.
sentences.zh: 她告诉法拉，自从她的故事在《时报》上发表后，她收到了很多信息和卡片。

sentences.en: At first, it was very overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 起初，这让我感到非常不知所措。

sentences.en: Very overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 非常不知所措。

sentences.en: I did not know or expect any of that kind of reaction from anybody.
sentences.zh: 我完全没料到，也没想到会收到这样的反响。

sentences.en: What was the reaction like?
sentences.zh: 反响如何？

sentences.en: People telling me, you know, that they were inspired by my courage and how I held myself together throughout everything.
sentences.zh: 人们告诉我，他们被我的勇气所鼓舞，以及我在经历这一切时是如何保持坚强的。

sentences.en: And then one day, an even bigger surprise, Shannon got a Facebook message from Tadeo, the Mexican worker she had trained.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，一个更大的惊喜出现了，香农收到了塔德奥发来的Facebook消息，就是她曾经培训过的那个墨西哥工人。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're friends on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们在Facebook上是好友。

sentences.en: Would you like for me to read what he said to you?
sentences.zh: 你想让我读读他给你写的内容吗？

sentences.en: Or said to me, I mean?
sentences.zh: 或者说写给我的，我是说？

sentences.en: Okay, let me see.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我看看。

sentences.en: It said, I found you.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，我找到你了。

sentences.en: It took me a long time to find you because I did not remember your last name until I saw the New York Times article.
sentences.zh: 我花了好长时间才找到你，因为在看到《纽约时报》的文章之前，我不记得你的姓氏。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for everything.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你所做的一切。

sentences.en: I am grateful to life for having known you.
sentences.zh: 我很感激生命中能遇见你。

sentences.en: Sorry for my English.
sentences.zh: 抱歉我的英语不好。

sentences.en: You know I need to practice more because we'd always joke around about that.
sentences.zh: 你知道我需要多练习，因为我们总是拿这个开玩笑。

sentences.en: And then you and your family are welcome in Mexico, Monterey.
sentences.zh: 还有，你和你的家人在墨西哥蒙特雷随时受到欢迎。

sentences.en: My house is your house.
sentences.zh: 我的家就是你的家。

sentences.en: If someday you travel to Mexico, you know that you have a friend.
sentences.zh: 如果哪天你来墨西哥旅行，你知道你有一个朋友。

sentences.en: I am really grateful and I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激，也很抱歉。

sentences.en: I'm really sorry for everything that happened to Rex Norton.
sentences.zh: 对于雷克斯诺顿发生的一切，我真的感到很抱歉。

sentences.en: Anything I can help with, you know that you have me.
sentences.zh: 任何我能帮忙的地方，你知道你随时可以找我。

sentences.en: I am proud to be a part of that story.
sentences.zh: 我很自豪能成为那个故事的一部分。

sentences.en: I want to congratulate you on your daughter's great achievement.
sentences.zh: 我想祝贺你女儿取得的伟大成就。

sentences.en: I am proud of you and thank you very much for teaching me so much.
sentences.zh: 我为你感到骄傲，非常感谢你教了我那么多。

sentences.en: Did you respond?
sentences.zh: 你回复了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, of course I did.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然回复了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I said that means a lot.
sentences.zh: 我说那对我意义重大。

sentences.en: In the future, if you come to the U.S., you always have a friend here, me.
sentences.zh: 将来如果你来美国，你永远在这里有一个朋友，就是我。

sentences.en: What about strangers who wrote to you?
sentences.zh: 那些写信给你的陌生人呢？

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 开始了。

sentences.en: Hold on.
sentences.zh: 等一下。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It says, you're probably wondering who I am.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，你可能在想我是谁。

sentences.en: I heard your interview on a podcast I faithfully listened to.
sentences.zh: 我在一个我忠实收听的播客上听到了你的采访。

sentences.en: The Daily with Michael Barbera.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·巴贝罗主持的《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: And I just want to wish you the best and let you know that your story was heard and my heart goes out to you and your family and your dogs.
sentences.zh: 我只是想祝你一切顺利，让你知道你的故事被听到了，我衷心地祝福你、你的家人和你的狗狗们。

sentences.en: LOL.
sentences.zh: 哈哈。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: It's a shame you don't live near me because there's tons of work out here.
sentences.zh: 真可惜你不住在我附近，因为这里有很多工作机会。

sentences.en: Lots and lots of jobs in manufacturing and warehouse.
sentences.zh: 制造业和仓库里有很多很多工作。

sentences.en: I just got laid off from Coca-Cola myself, but I have been another job, $17 an hour within a week.
sentences.zh: 我自己刚从可口可乐被裁员，但一周内我就找到了另一份工作，时薪17美元。

sentences.en: If there's anything I can do to help, let me know.
sentences.zh: 如果有什么我能帮忙的，请告诉我。

sentences.en: So, I don't have a lot, but I'd love to put together a care package together for you if you need it.
sentences.zh: 虽然我没有多少钱，但如果你需要的话，我很乐意为你准备一个爱心包裹。

sentences.en: I am sure you've probably already had an outpouring of support, but if there's anything I can do, let me know.
sentences.zh: 我相信你可能已经得到了很多支持，但如果有什么我能做的，请告诉我。

sentences.en: Well, let me ask you this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我问你一个问题。

sentences.en: Does it change the way you think of the country that you've gotten so many people who are responding?
sentences.zh: 收到这么多人的回应，这改变了你对这个国家的看法吗？

sentences.en: Yes, because I didn't think that anybody would care.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为我没想到会有人关心。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: I didn't expect all that.
sentences.zh: 我没预料到会这样。

sentences.en: I really didn't.
sentences.zh: 真的没有。

sentences.en: But I'm glad that it did.
sentences.zh: 但我很高兴确实发生了。

sentences.en: Since she lost her job, Shannon has spent time repairing her house and caring for Carmela.
sentences.zh: 自从失业后，香农花时间修理房子并照顾卡梅拉。

sentences.en: She still doesn't have a job.
sentences.zh: 她仍然没有工作。

sentences.en: And she's still looking.
sentences.zh: 而且她还在寻找。
